scenarios.prompt: A tool spends condition on authored use events and can be repaired. Define idempotent wear/repair transactions and project-specific warning thresholds.

criteria.policy: Wear sources, multipliers, warnings and recovery are explicit project data.
criteria.transactions: Duplicate wear/repair events do not double-spend or double-restore condition.
criteria.evidence: Threshold, interruption, break/minimum-state and save/load cases reconcile condition.
